results.title: OPIK-1778: Fix read consistency issues
results.extractability_reason: titolo e corpo contengono 255 caratteri: la valutazione prosegue
results.accepted_requirement: If a thread is pending closure, then the system shall complete and publish its closure so that subsequent reads reflect the thread's correct closed state.

iteration_history.candidate: If a thread is pending closure, then the system shall complete and publish its closure so that subsequent reads reflect the thread's correct closed state.

retrieved_requirements.statement: If a value in an OpenTelemetry span looks like JSON but cannot be parsed as valid JSON, then the system shall store that value as plain text instead of raising an exception.
When a thread is closed, the system shall guarantee that subsequent reads of that thread return consistent, up-to-date data reflecting the closure.

relations.reason: Both concern read consistency around thread closure, but the earlier one guarantees consistent reads after closure while the candidate obliges the system to complete and publish closures that are pending.

issues: The requirement overlaps with the previously validated requirement from Pull Request #2695, which guarantees consistent, up-to-date reads after a thread is closed; the candidate states the complementary obligation of actually completing and publishing closure for threads pending closure. Neither contains the other, so both are retained; this is recorded as an observation and does not affect the decision.
The candidate covers only the thread-closure part of the evidence; the null-pointer fix in the Online Scoring subscriber is a separate matter and its omission is not a defect of this sentence.

results.title: OPIK-1778: Fix issues with read consistency by send entities into events
results.extractability_reason: titolo e corpo contengono 220 caratteri: la valutazione prosegue
results.accepted_requirement: If an entity is created or modified, then the system shall ensure that subsequent reads of that entity return consistent, up-to-date data.

iteration_history.candidate: If an entity is created or modified, then the system shall ensure that subsequent reads of that entity return consistent, up-to-date data.

retrieved_requirements.statement: If a value in an OpenTelemetry span looks like JSON but cannot be parsed as valid JSON, then the system shall store that value as plain text instead of raising an exception.
When a thread is closed, the system shall guarantee that subsequent reads of that thread return consistent, up-to-date data reflecting the closure.
If a thread is pending closure, then the system shall complete and publish its closure so that subsequent reads reflect the thread's correct closed state.

relations.reason: Both guarantee that subsequent reads return consistent, up-to-date data, the earlier one only for a closed thread and the candidate for any created or modified entity.
Both concern subsequent reads reflecting an entity's current state, the earlier one specifically for threads pending closure.

issues: The requirement states, at the general level the evidence supports, the read-consistency guarantee that the Pull Request describes, without naming the event mechanism used to achieve it.

It overlaps with the read-consistency requirement from Pull Request #2695 (thread closure) and with the one from Pull Request #2719 (pending thread closure): the candidate expresses the same kind of guarantee for entities generally, while those earlier requirements remain narrower and specific to thread closure. This is recorded as an observation and does not affect the decision.
The evidence also mentions a second, unrelated change (aligning the LLM-as-Judge template with the JSON schema property name); that belongs to a separate requirement and is not a defect of this one.
